rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a building with communal bathing facilities.

example.english: This bathhouse has several large communal baths.
example.traditional: 呢間公共浴室有幾個大浴池。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 gung1 gung6 juk6 sat1 jau5 gei2 go3 daai6 juk6 ci4

rows.note: Use this specifically for a gay bathhouse serving mainly as a place for sexual encounters.

example.english: This gay bathhouse is especially busy at night.
example.traditional: 呢間同志浴室夜晚特別多人。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 tung4 zi3 juk6 sat1 je6 maan5 dak6 bit6 do1 jan4

rows.note: Use this at a swimming pool when the bathhouse refers to the swimmers' changing-room building.

example.english: After swimming, we went to the bathhouse to change clothes.
example.traditional: 游水之後，我哋去更衣室換衫。
example.jyutping: jau4 seoi2 zi1 hau6 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 gang1 ji1 sat1 wun6 saam1
